analysis.title: GS Sharkey - Extremes 1 Nov 2026
key_insights: GS PB net sold -$4.2bn of tech on Friday, the largest single-day sell skew in tech over the past 3 weeks, and finished the week as net sellers, fully reversing a +$5bn mid-week buy skew.
Early-week tech re-risking faded after disappointing mega-cap prints: INTC on PC weakness, AMZN on weak FCF and higher buyside AWS expectations plus search weakness, and MSFT beat but closed lower.
GS net sold -$21bn of TMT at the peak of the current unwind, versus -$23bn in the July AI sell-off.
NDX vs S&P Equal Weight had its worst month of underperformance since 2002. SOX closed below its 200dma for the first time since June 2025 and is -27.1% from its local high.

S&P ex-AI gained +7.64% in the month, its best month since the launch of ChatGPT. AI vs 'AI at Risk' had its second-worst month since ChatGPT launched. Software vs Semis outperformed by 27%, the second-biggest monthly gap since 2015.
Global TMT L/S funds are down -11.9% MTD and +5.7% YTD. The HF VIP vs VIP Short basket had its 3rd worst month in 15 years. GS expects the need to protect PnL to limit offense in the near term.

Mag7 exposure is near the YTD highs and at the top of its 5-year range going into earnings. The group was net sold in 4 of the last 5 sessions and GS expects it to remain a source of funds, limiting dip-buying demand. Retail is flagged as a wildcard that could offset some weakness.
Global equities were net bought for the first time in a month (+0.3 SD 1-year) while de-grossing continued for a 3rd straight week, with short covers outpacing long sales 1.8 to 1.
Macro Products (index and ETF) saw the largest net buying in 3 months, 73% of total net buying (+1.2 SD 1-year), driven by short covers and long buys at 1.9 to 1.

Overall book gross leverage is 314.1% (85th percentile 1-year, 97th percentile 5-year). Net leverage is 73.6% (10th percentile 1-year). Beta-adjusted fundamental L/S net leverage at 64.8% is a 1-year low.

Q3 2026 S&P 500 EPS growth is on track for 33% y/y, matching Q2 as the strongest in recent decades outside post-recession recoveries, but it ends the pattern of acceleration. Q3 beats are smaller than in Q1 and Q2.
Defensives are bid: BRK/B, KO, PM, ABBV and AAPL (acting defensive) all hit all-time highs within the last 2 weeks.
Brazil led EM net selling, its largest net selling in 5 years, with long selling exceeding short selling.

Midterm baskets: a Democratic sweep favors ACA beneficiaries (GSHLCACA). AI Power (GSENEPOW) is preferred over ex-Power AI hardware (GSTMTAIH). Corporate tax (GSPUTAXP) risk is a higher rate beyond 2029, with 2027-28 earnings largely insulated.

sector_views.rationale: Heavy net selling, SOX below its 200dma, crowded Mag7 exposure expected to act as a source of funds.
Software outperformed Semis by 27% in the month, the second-biggest monthly outperformance since 2015.
BRK/B, KO, PM, ABBV and AAPL hit all-time highs and the bid for defensives remains strong.
A Democratic sweep in the midterms reviving enhanced ACA subsidies would help hospitals, providers and insurers.

earnings_insights: S&P 500 Q3 2026 EPS growth is on track for 33% y/y (estimate, quarter still reporting), matching Q2 and ending the pattern of acceleration.
S&P 500 Q3 2026 EPS has exceeded estimates by a smaller magnitude than in Q1 and Q2.
INTC reported weak results on PC weakness (already printed, the report gives no figures).
AMZN reported with weak FCF and higher buyside AWS expectations (bogeys) than results met, plus search weakness (already printed, no figures given).
MSFT beat estimates but the stock closed lower (already printed, no figures given).

macro_indicators.interpretation: Matches Q2 as the strongest quarter in recent decades outside post-recession recoveries, but ends the acceleration pattern.

trade_ideas.description: Long ACA beneficiaries basket (GSHLCACA) as a Democratic midterm sweep trade
trade_ideas.rationale: Reviving the enhanced subsidies helps hospitals, providers and insurers.

trade_ideas.description: Long AI Power basket (GSENEPOW) over ex-Power AI hardware (GSTMTAIH)
trade_ideas.rationale: Increasing power supply is portrayed as a solution to electricity inflation, while policymaker convergence on datacenter cost bearing could weaken datacenter project economics and weigh on ex-Power hardware.

risk_factors: Mag7 crowding and continued selling as a source of funds.
Further AI length unwinding after disappointing mega-cap earnings.
Hedge fund performance pain limiting risk appetite.
A higher corporate tax rate beyond 2029.
Policymaker convergence on datacenter cost bearing weakening datacenter project economics.
